strengths: The primary capability set is all present, in a clean, rhythmic order: one URL, then explore, journeys, recordings and root cause (ch03), then schedule, staging/preview/localhost and every pull request (ch04). The triplet in ch04 lands like a promo should.

The time bugs use real, exact numbers from the bible (67 ms, four dropped frames, no click, 258 re-fetches, checkpoint stuck at -1), shown on the real bug pages with the open/fixed status kept honest. Stopping the music for four beats on 'Four dropped frames' is a memorable way to make dropped time felt.
The developer/critic beat is correctly subtle (unnarrated, 0.6 scale, a corner, generic unbranded agents, never called the page's judges) and grounded in the documented fix-and-rerun loop.

Guardrails are carefully respected: 'night' is never put over the weekly chip, the 258 bug and the Insights 258 never share a frame, nobody claims Replay QA fixed a bug, the URL is a placeholder, and no credits or chat column appear in any crop.
The bookended 'only exist in time' line ties the hook into the sign-off, and the narration is written for the ear: short lines, numbers spoken naturally.
